newsitem.title: UK: UK construction orders up 2.0 pct latest quarter.
newsitem.headline: UK construction orders up 2.0 pct latest quarter.

text.p: UK new construction orders rose 2.0 percent in the third quarter of 1996 from the second and were up 6.0 pct from Q3 1995, the Department of the Environment said.

The sharp rise from a low August level was due to the infrastructure and private industrial sectors having their highest levels of orders in 1996, as well as a large rise in the public non housing sector, the DOE said.
New orders for private housing sector up 2.0 pct in the quarter and 7.0 on a year ago.
Public housing, housing association orders rose 20 pct in Q3 and 3.0 percent up on a year ago. Infrastructure orders rose 23 percent in the third quarter and 17 percent year-on-year.
* Current prices total value of new orders in Sept was 1.805 billion stg.
